info.headline: Notify NYC - Silver Alert - Henry Ackle
info.description:
Silver Alert issued 10-09-2026 at 07:03 AM.
A Silver Alert has been issued for Henry Ackle, a 75-year-old black male, last seen near East 48th Street and Church Avenue in Brooklyn at approximately 8:00 PM on 10-08-2026. Mr. Ackle has dementia, may seem disoriented, and may be in need of medical attention.
Description: Last seen wearing a burgundy-colored shirt, blue jean shorts, and brown slippers.
If you see Henry, please call 1-800-577-8477 (TIPS) or 9-1-1.
A photo of Henry is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sFbyiJ
